text: The factory takes back only regular files from an agent's workspace (#153's step 3), through one package, internal/regular, which every draft, plan and build read goes through. A symbolic link anywhere on a file's path, or a hard link to a file elsewhere, is refused by name and never followed; os.Root keeps a link swapped in meanwhile from reaching outside the workspace, and a pipe is refused before it's opened. A walk reads only what the factory takes, so a tool's own link, such as a Python environment's, stops nothing. Codex's agent has a shell, which can leave a link to the App key that the agent can't read but the factory can, so this lands before Codex runs. internal/regular/ joins the trusted base.
